test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 6 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 7(1/3) hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?"
solution:
**Given:**

Pump fills tank = 6 hours

With leakage, time = 7¹/₃ hours = 22/3 hours

**Formula used:**

Work rate = 1 / time

Leak rate = Pump rate − Net rate

Leak empty time = 1 ÷ Leak rate

**Calculations:**

⇒ Pump rate = 1/6

⇒ Net rate = 1 ÷ (22/3) = 3/22

⇒ Leak rate = 1/6 − 3/22

⇒ Leak rate = (11 − 9) / 66 = 2/66 = 1/33

⇒ Leak empty time = 1 ÷ (1/33) = 33

**∴ Leak alone can empty the full tank in 33 hours**
